businesses.business: asset integrity testing and engineering services

offering_description.value: Provides tech-enabled testing, inspection, certification, compliance and engineering services for critical assets and infrastructure. Serves industrial, energy, utility and public infrastructure owners across the asset lifecycle, from design through operation.

quotes.quote: TIC Solutions serves diversified end markets that are essential to the broader economy, including industrials, energy processing, utilities, and both public and commercial infrastructure, with exposure to data centers and other high-growth adjacencies. As the parent company of Acuren and NV5, we integrate deep domain expertise, local presence, and global standards to solve our clients’ most complex challenges.

TIC Solutions is a leading provider of critical asset integrity solutions, which includes tech-enabled testing, inspection, certification, and compliance (TICC) and engineering services. TIC Solutions serves diversified end markets that are essential to the communities where we live and work, including industrials, infrastructure, energy, midstream, and renewables.

primary_products.value: proprietary inspection software; drone-based geospatial analytics
